correctness.rationale: For q=1 recursive pairing of incoming B/C trees gives a quotient whose every merged preimage fiber has size at most the maximum source fiber; no side-internal identifications occur. For k=1 finite maps are permutations and disjoint cycle union gives SAP. For k>=2 a fixed point with two saturated side extensions rules out SAP; adding differently coloured fresh predecessors over a (k-1)-saturated fixed point rules out AP when q>=2. Explicit regular-tree limits follow from the finite extension property. The standalone checker tested 13,169 finite diagrams and cap-specific obstructions; exhaustive finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a sharp parameter-wide structural phase diagram for an analytically natural class of locally bounded functional structures. The positive side requires a non-free recursive tree-folding amalgam and leads to an explicit homogeneous regular-preimage limit; the one additional named colour switches on the first obstruction. It distinguishes AP from SAP uniformly and supplies finite, smallest-type obstruction witnesses instead of a merely formal restatement of the general Fraïssé theorem.
